title: Pole replacement with crane near 11 kV lines, Scoresby VIC

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Morning all. This is the pole replacement on Ferntree Gully Road, Scoresby, pole SCB 2214. Work order 5530917.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: We're swapping the rotten pole for a new concrete one. The eleven kV stays on the new crossarm, and there's LV underbuilt.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: The HV is isolated and earthed under access permit AP 7731, the switching operator confirmed it at six thirty. The LV is still live, so we treat it as live.
lines.asr_hypothesis: The HV is isolated and earthed under access permit AP 7731, the switching operator confirmed it at six thirty. The LV is still alive, so we treat it as live.

lines.speaker: Guest-4
lines.text: Crane's a forty tonne Franna. I'll set up on the eastern side, outriggers fully extended on the mats.

lines.speaker: Guest-4
lines.text: Closest I'll get the boom to the LV is about three metres, so I want a dedicated spotter on the boom the whole time.

lines.speaker: Guest-3
lines.text: I'll spot for you Dave. And we'll put the tiger tails on the LV so it's covered.
lines.asr_hypothesis: I'll spot for you Dave. And we'll put the tiger tails on the L V so it's covered.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Ferntree Gully Road's a sixty zone and it's busy, heaps of trucks. We'll have to watch the traffic.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Yep, everyone keep an eye on the traffic.

lines.speaker: Guest-5
lines.text: Unit forty two, are you clear of the Boronia job yet, over.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Suspended load. Nobody under the pole while it's on the hook, and use tag lines to steer it.

lines.speaker: Guest-3
lines.text: The old pole's rotten at the base, so it could snap when we take the load. Crane takes the weight before we cut anything.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: I'll be in the EWP for the crossarm transfer. Harness on, clipped to the anchor point.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Dial before you dig is done for the new hole and we potholed yesterday. There's a Telstra pit two metres away but nothing in line with the auger.

lines.speaker: Guest-3
lines.text: Who's grabbing coffee? I'll have a flat white.

lines.speaker: Guest-2
lines.text: Servo's got that new machine, I'll duck over after.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Weather, a bit of wind around midday. If it's gusting over thirty k's we stop the lift.

lines.speaker: Guest-4
lines.text: Yep, I'll call it off the wind meter on the crane.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Emergency. Muster point is the bus stop on the north side of Ferntree Gully Road. Nearest hospital is the Angliss in Upper Ferntree Gully.

lines.speaker: Guest-3
lines.text: I'm the first aider, kit's in the tray of my ute. Comms is UHF channel eighteen between us and the crane.

lines.speaker: Guest-1
lines.text: Good. Anything else? No? Let's sign on.
